value.text: Place.Name is explicitly bound to places.name in INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING id. Only a newly inserted row calls InsertRequest, which serializes the complete Place into request_outbox.payload.place and inserts it in the same transaction. An existing city leaves both the stored Place and outbox unchanged; the transaction still commits. SQL, serialization or commit failure prevents normal completion of this shown Save path.
